articles.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

articles.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
articles.snippet: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

articles.title: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says
articles.snippet: The SkyBridge founder said disputes over ethics restrictions also stalled negotiations, with both sides responsible for the setback.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin says phased reopening to begin Monday, will cover losses
articles.snippet: Customers will initially be able to view their holdings, while withdrawals and trading remain suspended pending security checks.

articles.title: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange’s founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.
